chunks: To quicken a region that was dead, and to give it as drink to animals We have created and to men in plenty.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of rain according to Surah Al-Furqan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transformative power of divine water as a sign of resurrection, linking physical revival to spiritual awakening. It emphasizes God's comprehensive provision (rizq) for both animals and humans, illustrating the interconnectedness of creation under divine sovereignty.
